description: A valid UI color system declares semantic roles with mode coverage, interactive deltas, a focus indicator, and a WCAG compliance target.

rules.description: The destructive semantic role must be declared. It maps to error, danger, and delete actions — its absence makes danger states unverifiable.
A focusIndicator section must specify the focus ring color and its adjacent surface. Required for WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11 (Non-text Contrast) compliance.
The project must explicitly declare its WCAG target level (AA or AAA). Without this, contrast gate thresholds are ambiguous.
At least one non-light mode (dark or high-contrast) should be declared to support accessibility requirements and user preference media queries.
Every semantic role entry must have an id field. The id is the machine-readable identifier used by downstream compilers to reference the role.
